title: Core statistical content (ICH E9)
source_note: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials (1998)

items.title: Endpoints defined
items.requirement: Primary and secondary variables are defined precisely (measurement, timepoint, derivation).

items.title: Design, randomisation and blinding
items.requirement: Design type, control, randomisation method (stratification, blocking handled confidentially) and blinding are described.

items.title: Crossover specifics (if applicable)
items.requirement: For crossover designs: washout adequacy, carryover considerations and period effects in the model are addressed.
items.query: crossover design carryover washout period effects

items.title: Hypotheses and type I error
items.requirement: Hypotheses (superiority / non-inferiority / equivalence), sidedness and significance level are stated; any NI or equivalence margin is justified.
items.query: superiority equivalence non-inferiority margin one-sided two-sided significance level

items.title: Analysis sets
items.requirement: Full analysis set, per-protocol set and safety set are defined, with the role of each in the analyses.
items.query: full analysis set per protocol set intention to treat

items.title: Primary analysis model
items.requirement: The primary model is fully specified, including pre-specified covariates and handling of centres/sites.
items.query: covariates adjustment pre-specified primary analysis model centres

items.title: Sample size justification
items.requirement: Sample size assumptions (effect, variability, alpha, power, dropout) are stated with their sources.
items.query: sample size calculation assumptions variability power

items.title: Multiplicity
items.requirement: The approach to multiple endpoints, comparisons, timepoints and interim looks is described.
items.query: multiplicity adjustment multiple primary variables comparisons

items.title: Interim analyses and monitoring
items.requirement: Interim analyses, stopping rules, alpha spending and data monitoring arrangements are specified (or stated as none).
items.query: interim analysis stopping guidelines data monitoring committee

items.title: Missing values and deviations
items.requirement: Handling of missing values, outliers and protocol deviations is pre-specified.

items.title: Subgroups and interactions
items.requirement: Subgroup analyses are pre-specified and interpreted via interaction / consistency, not as confirmatory unless planned.

items.title: Safety analyses
items.requirement: Safety and tolerability analyses (adverse events, lab data) are described.
